condition: to_stata with convert_dates "tw" stores Dec 31 (and Dec 30 in leap years) as week 1 of the next year instead of week 52 of the same year.
workaround: Before writing, compute the %tw values yourself and cap the week index at 51, e.g. 52*(year-1960) + np.minimum(dayofyear0 // 7, 51). Another option is to move Dec 30/31 dates back into week 52.
